AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem? (1 mark)

   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)

   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel
